top_stories.title: Mistral launches open-source Mistral Large 4, details AI roadmap
top_stories.description: Mistral AI SAS today opened access to Mistral Large 4, its most capable large language model to date. On launch, the LLM is available in public preview through the company’s cloud platform. Mistral plans to release the model’s weights later this month. top_stories.description: OpenAI Group PBC has published 722 math papers that it generated using an unreleased artificial intelligence model.
